metadata.entry_policy: Manual operator confirmation is required at each selected route start: main-corridor starts at robot-start, facing toward the top of the reference image; side-corridor starts at red-bucket, at the stopped main-corridor junction with the bucket beside the robot's left side and the same forward heading. Stop there before reporting a blockage of the next segment, while completion confirmation is pending. Confirm side-corridor entry only after checking the actual position and heading. If blocked before or beyond this junction, withhold alternate entry and wait for timeout/escalation; no connector, backtracking or autonomous scene localization is inferred. Object nodes denote operator-checked safe observation positions beside objects, not their occupied coordinates. This layout is synthetic_not_surveyed; no measured clearance or accessibility is claimed.
